summary: Preserve JetBrains system caches and Local History during explicit cleanup

delivery.outcome: Independently publish and deploy explicit JetBrains cleanup that preserves mixed system caches and irreplaceable Local History while retaining existing stale installation cleanup.
nonGoals: No deletion of host IDE data or user history
No new cleanup category, package dependency, retention or storage threshold
No change to legacy stale installation eligibility

architecture.decision: Exclude whole JetBrains system-cache roots from explicit cleanup candidates and explain the protection in existing text/JSON previews and CLI help.
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected publication; no host cleanup is part of deployment.
